name: irs-pub15t-2026-percentage-method
source_authority: Internal Revenue Service, Publication 15-T (2026), Federal Income Tax Withholding Methods, Section 1: Percentage Method Tables for Automated Payroll Systems and Withholding on Periodic Payments of Pensions and Annuities (STANDARD Withholding Rate Schedules, ANNUAL) and Worksheet 1A (Employer's Withholding Worksheet for Percentage Method Tables for Automated Payroll Systems)
retrieval_provenance: 0xAlpha/audits/2026-08-23-PAYROLL-2026-CORRECTION-SPEC.md (job J2 of 0xAlpha/RETRIEVAL-JOBS-2026-08-23.md). Publisher HTML edition title page states 'Publication 15-T (2026)' / 'For use in 2026'; footer 'Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 30-Apr-2026'. Section 1 is the automated-payroll percentage method in the 2026 edition (Section 4 is the MANUAL payroll percentage method; the 2025 dataset's 'Section 4' citation reflected the 2025 edition's numbering).
locator_gap: UNRETRIEVED-FORMAT: the publisher's HTML edition carries no PDF revision stamp, no catalog number and no printed page numbers. Locators therefore pin to document title + section heading + table name + line item, which the HTML provides stably. PDF-page pinning is recorded as N/A rather than guessed.
license: CC0-for-our-compilation (the underlying IRS table values are U.S. government works and not subject to copyright; this compilation, its structure, and digest are released CC0)
note: STANDARD Withholding Rate Schedules only (Form W-4 Step 2 checkbox NOT checked, or Form W-4 is from 2019 or earlier). The Form W-4, Step 2, Checkbox Withholding Rate Schedules (a separate, lower-threshold table for the two-jobs checkbox case) are NOT included in this dataset -- compute_federal_withholding declares that as an explicit out-of-scope limitation. Bracket math independently re-derived and cross-checked bracket-to-bracket against the published base-tax figures (each bracket's base equals the prior bracket's base plus prior-bracket-width times prior-bracket-rate) -- all three schedules below passed that check exactly.
sha256_method: sha256 (hex) over the UTF-8 bytes of JSON.stringify({ pay_periods_per_year, multiple_jobs_backout_amount, annual_percentage_method_standard }) -- the three data members only, in that key order, with no whitespace. Prose fields are deliberately excluded so the digest pins the TABLE VALUES and nothing else, and so any reader can re-derive it in one line without reproducing this file's formatting.
